strings.briefing:
This catalog was merged from four vendor feeds and nobody agreed on a format. SKUs picked up stray whitespace in transit. Category names drift between UPPER, Title, and lower case depending on which feed wrote them last. And quantity — which should be a plain integer — came back as free text for a chunk of rows, so the whole column reads as text now.

Three separate problems, one table. Fix them in whatever order makes sense; CASE_SHIFT doesn't care which you clear first.
